Native/media and real Demo remain unproved; exclusions do not remove the named screen-position rule.

proposed_test_cases.premise: One target, two distinct valid ordinary animations A/B, no screen-suppression conflict
proposed_test_cases.expected: Both continue independently; adding B does not cancel A. Internal free-slot reuse not prescribed.

proposed_test_cases.premise: Ordinary valid effect reaches its duration; temporary tile display then gets normal update
proposed_test_cases.expected: Effect becomes false; temporary display disposes. Explicit parent disposal normally retires both families; exception recovery not guaranteed.

proposed_test_cases.premise: Valid nonempty loop request through fresh parent wrapper
proposed_test_cases.expected: New child reads missing ordinary-animation frame count before registration; already-active ordinary requests are not canceled. Existing B04-W21, not a new defect.

proposed_test_cases.premise: Valid screen-position3 ordinary animation, 512×384 viewport, visible cell offset(0,0), character parent oldx100, next requestedx110; no competing requests, active animation, normal native assignment, no extra update after character return
proposed_test_cases.expected: Child reanchors x256 then parent x propagation adds10; after character update x266. Next stationary update returns to256. y224 if parenty unchanged.

proposed_test_cases.premise: S04 only change: temporary tile animation consumer whose coordinates are set before animation update; or stationary character
proposed_test_cases.expected: End-of-update screen anchor remains256; target-relative0/1/2 counterpart normally follows new parent position.

proposed_test_cases.premise: Initially empty suppression window; same valid position3 record requested twice through tile-animation entry at tiles(0,0)/(1,0), map display0, standard32tile; no parent update between requests, no timing callbacks, duration still active, both constructions normal
proposed_test_cases.expected: First request has cells; second is registered active but has none. Its next setCoords requests x32 from stored48, delta−16; first missing cell causes local failure before parent x assignment or normal auto-disposal.

proposed_test_cases.premise: S06 with a normal parent update between requests; independently change position to0/1/2
proposed_test_cases.expected: Clear window or non-screen position permits second request cells and removes this sparse-cell failure. Same numeric graphics in distinct record identities are not assumed identical animation identity.

proposed_test_cases.premise: Steady ordinary Rain particle x100.0/y100.0, life positive/no boundary crossing, velocity(−600,2400), two dt=.001 updates, no reset/other writes
proposed_test_cases.expected: Stored coordinate arithmetic x99.4 then98.8; y102.4 then104.8, subject to normal floating representation. Do not quantize after each write. Native pixel rounding is not asserted.

proposed_test_cases.premise: Weather tiled layer fractional origin updated normally, resource size valid
proposed_test_cases.expected: Origin accumulation preserves fractions, but per-tile coordinate projection explicitly rounds; not all weather layers promise fractional requested coordinates.
